expectation: Membrane PD1 on a subset of CD4 T cells (brightest on Tfh), rare to moderate. Cells should be scattered singly and concentrated in lymphoid aggregates or follicles, with the rest of the tissue near-empty.
observed: A: focal dense yellow clusters in several ROIs (aggregate-like), but two ROIs are uniformly hazy and others show sparse speckle. B/C: faint speckle with a few bright foci. D: pixelated haze. E: PD1 forms discrete clumps inside CD4-rich zones; most CD4 is PD1-negative.
why: PD1 clusters in aggregate-like foci within CD4-rich zones, but contrast is low and haze and speckle in several ROIs undermine it.
